description:
Check out “The Book” here: https://mdsh.io/nostalgianerd
Use code NERD for 10% off ~ The BBC Literacy Project was just the start. What would follow was the BBC Domesday Project. This led to The Domesday Machine and the Domesday Discs, which when combined, had more knowledge contained about the 80s, than anything else at the time. Join me for The 40th Anniversary of this incredible project, as I talk to the folks to actually created it.

Huge thank you to The Centre for Computing History and everyone who allowed me to chat to them!
